segments.he: עִקַּר הַתְּפִלָּה הִיא בִּבְחִינַת תְּפִלָּה לֶעָנִי
segments.en: And when the aspect of Pharaoh and Egypt — which is the Sitra Achra and its forces — pursues a person with confusions and evil thoughts, with no place to flee forward or backward or to the sides — if he wants to look back, they will certainly overpower him further. Therefore there is no remedy except to cry out to Hashem from wherever he is, and not to turn and look backward at all. For everything that passed over Yisrael at the exodus from Egypt and at the receiving of the Torah, and afterward, and all the wars to conquer the Land of Yisrael, and all that has passed over us afterward — all of this, in its entirety, passes over every person who wishes to merit eternal life. And at every time he wishes to arouse himself and strengthen himself in the service of Hashem, they intensify each time further — especially at the beginning. Therefore one must always cry out to Hashem and cast away and throw off all the false wisdoms from which all the confusions arise, and only walk in truth and simplicity — and then one will never be shaken. For cries and prayers and supplications and entreaties are always effective, whatever the situation.

segments.he: וְזֶה תִּכּוֹן תְּפִלָּתִי קְטרֶת לְפָנֶיךָ מַשְׂאַת כַּפַּי מִנְחַת עָרֶב.
segments.en: The essence of this aspect — of drawing close precisely through distance, in the aspect of "peace to the far and to the near" [Yeshayahu 57:19] — cannot be merited except through holy speech, and primarily through prayer. For the matter of far and near appears at first as if contradictory. And the essential peace and reconciliation between them is achieved through speech — for speech is the aspect of the bird whose feet stand in the water but whose head reaches to hear the heavens, as explained in the Torah teaching Ani Hashem Hu Shemi [Likutay Moharan 11:1].

segments.he: שֶׁעִקַּר הַתְּפִלָּה הִיא בִּבְחִינַת מִנְחַת עָרֶב בְּחִינַת תְּפִלָּה לֶעָנִי שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת הִתְבּוֹדְדוּת וְשִׂיחָה בֵּינוֹ לְבֵין קוֹנוֹ בְּחִינַת וְלִפְנֵי הַשֵּׁם יִשְׁפּךְ שִׂיחוֹ. שֶׁבְּעֵת שֶׁרוֹאֶה שֶׁהָאוֹר הוֹלֵךְ לְהִסְתַּלֵּק שֶׁזֶּהוּ בְּחִינַת בֵּין הָעַרְבַּיִם אָז צָרִיךְ לְהִתְגַּבֵּר בִּתְפִלָּה וְשִׂיחָה בִּבְחִינַת וַיֵּצֵא יִצְחָק לָשׂוּחַ בַּשָּׂדֶה. וְיִשְׁפּךְ לִבּוֹ כַּמַּיִם לִפְנֵי הַשֵּׁם בְּטֶרֶם יַעֲבר יוֹם. בִּבְחִינַת אוֹי לָנוּ כִּי פָּנָה הַיּוֹם כִּי יִנָּטוּ צִלְלֵי עָרֶב (יִרְמְיָה ב'): מִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן כְּשֶׁהָאָדָם רוֹאֶה שֶׁכְּבָר עָבְרוּ הַרְבֵּה מִיָּמָיו וּמִכָּל שֶׁכֵּן מִי שֶׁעָבְרוּ רב יָמָיו. וְהַיּוֹם מַתְחִיל לַעֲרב. כִּי לא יֵדַע הָאָדָם אֶת עִתּוֹ וְיָמֵינוּ כְּצֵל עוֹבֵר שֶׁצָּרִיךְ לְקַיֵּם וּזְכר אֶת בּוֹרַאֲךָ וְכוּ' עַד אֲשֶׁר לא תֶּחְשַׁךְ הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ וְהָאוֹר וְכוּ'. וְכָל זֶה הִיא בְּחִינַת תְּפִלַּת הַמִּנְחָה שֶׁהִיא בְּחִינַת תְּשׁוּבָה וְכַנַּ"ל. (שָׁם אוֹת כה):
segments.en: For a person must know the very extent of his distance from Hashem, and yet know and believe that from the side of Hashem's compassion He is very close to each and every person — even those very distant because of their bad deeds. And the essential way is through speech — for through speech we can call to Him from the farthest distance, and He draws close to us through this, as it is written: "Hashem is close to all who call Him, to all who call Him in truth" [Tehillim 145:18]. And: "What great nation is there that has G-d so close to it as Hashem our G-d is at all our calling to Him?" [Devarim 4:7]. And this is: "Creator of the fruit of the lips — peace, peace to the far and to the near" [Yeshayahu 57:19] — Creator of the fruit of lips specifically, for through the fruit of lips, through speech, precisely through this one merits the aspect of peace to the far and to the near.
